editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 19, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: unslothai/unsloth is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: unslothai/unsloth leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: unslothai/unsloth — 30 commits today and 1 same-day mapped article, 53.4 below its current daily pace, with 4 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
openclaw/openclaw — 249 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
earendil-works/pi — No same-day commit after 97 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Unsloth can refuse a disruptive model load instead of replacing a resident
dailyInsight.insight: October 19 merged Studio code extends residency policy across chat, image and video. Always can reject a different model rather than unload a protected one; the inspected October 15 beta does not contain the change.
dailyInsight.mechanism: Supported GPU paths compare free memory with estimated weights and generation headroom. Fit may free models; Always refuses displacement. A media swap can separately save the primary GGUF chat cache before unloading.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: Operators serving local agents alongside media work gain an explicit choice about which workload may displace another. Co-residency is conditional, and refusing a request can preserve the current service.

actions.audience: Operators serving chat and media through Unsloth Studio
actions.label: Check a containing release with one chat–media–chat sequence
actions.instruction: On a disposable setup, compare Fit and Always with the same models and GPU. Record resident models, refused requests and repeated prompt processing. Check idle expiry separately and preserve current configuration for rollback.
actions.effort: One bounded trial after a containing release is available

receipts.title: Explicit Always residency policy
receipts.supports: Adds refusal rather than protected-model displacement, settings migration and eviction reporting.

receipts.title: Chat and media co-residency
receipts.supports: Prices supported GPU loads and admits or refuses according to policy and available memory.

receipts.title: Settings and primary GGUF cache across media swaps
receipts.supports: Shows the three choices and best-effort save/restore for primary chat calculation cache.

confidence.basis: Pinned code, earlier multi-chat and modality baselines, public merges and fake-backend tests inspected; release ancestry checked.

dailyInsight.limitation: No independent GPU trial or test execution. Unsupported memory estimates can prevent coexistence. Always excludes training, idle expiry, Decision API and same-repository reconfiguration; cache save is best-effort primary GGUF only.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A containing release changes the policy, or a pinned supported-GPU trial unloads a protected different-repository model under Always outside the documented exceptions.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A released chat–media–chat trial reporting residency, refusal and repeated prompt processing on specified hardware.
